name: Norms: dominance (Axelrod)
description: Axelrod's dominance: 20 strong agents (punishment −3) and 10 weak (−9), each group reproducing within itself; the metric is the weak group's mean boldness after 100 generations. Measured (release, seeds 1–20, recorded 2026-09-26): 0.89 in the norms game and 0.02 with metanorms (the strong group's: 0.94 and 0.06 over 100 seeds). Without metanorms both groups end bold, as Axelrod says; with them the weak group is kept from being bold — and so is the strong group.
